note: The sizing half of hif-backend#91, kept apart from vhdl_ascending_range which covers the indexing half and declares no ascending-typed constant on purpose. hif2verilog sizes a bitvector literal as left-right+1, which is the width only for a descending range; for (0 to 3) it is -2, so `"1100"` is emitted as `-2'b1100`. iverilog takes two bits, truncates to 2'b00, negates to zero, warns twice and exits 0 - the mask becomes all zeros and y is always 0000 instead of a's high half. This design indexes nothing, so a fix to the index mapping alone cannot make it pass and a fix to the sizing alone cannot make vhdl_ascending_range pass.
